metas.name: The 10th Kingdom
metas.description: Virginia and Tony, a father and daughter living in Manhattan, find themselves in a parallel universe where Snow White, Cinderella and Little Red Riding Hood are struggling to maintain order. Their kingdoms have been fragmented by trolls, giants and goblins.

metas.name: Win or Lose
metas.description: As a championship game looms, eight characters are thrown a curveball in their off-the-field lives.
